close_reason: This pattern (get_state before/after update loop) is used identically in handle_submission_set and handle_email_set. It is a general JMAP server limitation, not a new defect introduced by MDN.
description: In handle_mdn_send step 7, email_old_state is fetched, then emails are updated one at a time in a loop, then email_new_state is fetched. In a concurrent server, another request modifying emails between get_state and the first update will produce a stale oldState in the Email/set response (it will include changes from the concurrent request). The JMAP state machine requires oldState to be the state before the MDN-triggered updates began. Trigger: two concurrent JMAP requests for the same account, one is MDN/send, the other updates any email. Bad behavior: Email/set companion response has wrong oldState, breaking client sync.
title: handle_mdn_send step 7 races on Email state — two get_state calls bracket per-entry updates
